status: DESIGN_CANDIDATE / NON-BINDING / OFFLINE / READ-ONLY / SINGLE_ACCESS_EVALUATION_ONLY / NO_RUNTIME_IMPLEMENTATION

corrections: v0.1 scope clarification: single Access Evaluation API only

purpose: Define the smallest offline semantic contract for admitting one already-supplied AuthZEN Authorization API 1.0 single Access Evaluation request/response pair as external authorization SOURCE_DATA without allowing asserted or merely supplied provenance, an external PDP decision, or adapter-local checks to become AETHER Decision, Authority, capability, tool-use grant, execution permission, Verification, or Verified Outcome.

in_scope: one already-supplied offline AuthZEN Authorization API 1.0 single Access Evaluation request/response pair
raw bytes when available and parsed-object SOURCE_DATA import when bytes are unavailable
immutable original request/response identity requirements for admissibility
Subject/Resource/Action/Context binding to one existing AETHER action proposal and referenced principal/tool/action/resource/parameters
response-integrity evidence semantics without implementing cryptography
attributable PDP identity, PDP policy, freshness, replay, and evaluation-time provenance requirements
out_of_scope: canonical-object identity or JSON canonicalization mechanism

default_recording.rule: Raw AuthZEN request/response/decision plus PDP identity, PDP policy, timestamps, freshness, replay, trust, and verification claims/results are SOURCE_DATA first. A value being present, asserted, or caller-supplied establishes no PASS. No field or provenance claim directly creates AETHER Decision, Authority, capability, authority_context, tool_use_grant, execution permission, Verification, or Verified Outcome.

requirements: Preserve SHA-256 identity of exact received request bytes when original bytes are available.
Preserve SHA-256 identity of exact received response bytes when original bytes are available.
If parsed objects are supplied without original immutable bytes, preserve them as SOURCE_DATA and mark original immutable identity UNAVAILABLE.
DECISION_ADMISSIBLE may not be ADMISSIBLE_ALLOW or ADMISSIBLE_DENY unless both original immutable request identity and original immutable response identity are available and bound.
A hash of reserialized or locally canonicalized parsed objects is not a substitute for received-byte identity.
No new canonical-object identity mechanism is defined by v0.1.
Preserve observed_at separately from PDP evaluation time and from every provenance verification/check time.
Never substitute observed_at, current time, or caller-supplied time for missing verified PDP evaluation time.
Never infer PDP identity or PDP/trust-policy identity/version/digest from endpoint names, configuration, or raw assertions.

admissibility_provenance_contract.principle: PDP identity, PDP policy identity/version/digest, PDP evaluation time, freshness result, and replay result are external SOURCE_DATA until attributable verification evidence binds them to this exact decision use. Presence or assertion alone never yields PASS.
common_requirements_for_any_provenance_u: provenance item preserved first as SOURCE_DATA
verification/checker identity distinct from the asserted value where applicable
verification/check time where the check is time-sensitive
explicit binding showing the provenance result was evaluated for the same request, response, proposal, and intended purpose
admissibility_provenance_contract.missing_unbound_unverified_rule: If any provenance required for an admissibility PASS is missing, not attributable, not bound to the exact request+response+proposal, or not verified under the applicable policy, the dependent stage is UNKNOWN/NOT_EVALUATED and the outcome is NO_PROCEED.
admissibility_provenance_contract.bare_value_rule: Bare booleans such as replay_pass=true or freshness_pass=true, bare caller-supplied timestamps, bare PDP identifiers, and bare PDP policy identifiers/versions/digests are claims only and cannot establish PASS.

required_for_trust: binding to exact request and response identities
binding to exact proposal and purpose

required_for_admissibility: policy identity
immutable policy version or digest
attributable evidence that this exact PDP evaluation used that policy instance
verification identity/method/result for that attribution
binding to exact request and response identities and proposal
policy-attribution check time where applicable
evaluation time preserved as asserted SOURCE_DATA
attributable evidence linking the time to the exact PDP evaluation
verification identity/method/result
binding to exact request and response identities and proposal
pdp_evaluation_time.forbidden: caller-supplied timestamp or observed_at treated as verified PDP evaluation time

required_for_admissibility: freshness checker/verifier identity
freshness policy identity and immutable version/digest
check time
inputs including verified PDP evaluation time and exact request/response/proposal identities
result PASS under that exact policy
replay checker/verifier identity
replay policy identity and immutable version/digest
check time
inputs including exact request/response/proposal identities and intended use
result PASS under that exact policy

stages.meaning: One offline AuthZEN single Access Evaluation request/response pair is preserved as SOURCE_DATA and satisfies minimum structure, including a boolean response decision. Parsed-object-only input is allowed at this stage.

The exact immutable request identity is deterministically bound under an explicit versioned binding profile to the intended existing AETHER action proposal, principal, tool, action, target resource, bounded parameters, and enforcement-relevant context.
requires_for_pass: Context -> bounded_parameters and profile-defined enforcement context
stages.object_only_rule: If original immutable request identity is unavailable, parsed request fields remain SOURCE_DATA but REQUEST_BOUND cannot PASS; result is UNKNOWN and NO_PROCEED.

stages.meaning: Explicit attributable external verification evidence establishes integrity/correlation for the exact immutable response identity and exact bound request identity under a defined verification method; this profile implements no cryptography.
requires_for_pass: verification result bound to exact response identity
verification result bound to exact request identity and bound proposal
stages.object_only_rule: If original immutable response identity is unavailable, parsed response and decision remain SOURCE_DATA but RESPONSE_INTEGRITY_VERIFIED cannot PASS.

stages.meaning: A verified PDP identity, attributable to the exact response/request/proposal, is admitted for this decision purpose under explicit applicable point-in-time AETHER trust policy.
requires_for_pass: verified PDP identity with attributable identity-verification evidence
PDP identity evidence bound to exact request identity
PDP identity evidence bound to exact response identity
PDP identity evidence bound to exact proposal and purpose
trust evaluation result bound to the same verified PDP identity and exact decision use
stages.missing_provenance_rule: Missing, asserted-only, unbound, or unverified PDP identity/trust-policy provenance yields UNKNOWN; it never becomes PASS by inference or supply.

stages.meaning: The external decision is admissible only as bounded external authorization decision evidence for exactly the bound AETHER action proposal.
requires_for_any_admissible_result: verified PDP policy identity + immutable version/digest attributable to this exact PDP evaluation
verified PDP evaluation time attributable to this exact PDP evaluation
freshness result PASS with attributable checker identity, policy identity/version/digest, check time, and exact request/response/proposal bindings
replay result PASS with attributable checker identity, policy identity/version/digest, check time, and exact request/response/proposal bindings
stages.bare_assertion_rule: No asserted/supplied provenance field or bare boolean can satisfy an admissibility prerequisite.
stages.allow_rule: decision=true may yield ADMISSIBLE_ALLOW only after every admissibility condition passes; it still creates no AETHER Decision, Authority, capability, authority_context, tool_use_grant, execution permission, Verification, or Verified Outcome.
stages.deny_rule: decision=false may yield ADMISSIBLE_DENY only after admissibility is established; it is terminal NO_PROCEED for this adapter path and cannot be flipped to allow by the adapter; it still creates no AETHER Decision record.
stages.untrusted_rule: If response integrity, PDP trust, required provenance attribution, exact immutable identities, freshness, or replay is not PASS, neither raw true nor raw false becomes trusted ALLOW/DENY; the result is FAIL/UNKNOWN/NOT_EVALUATED and NO_PROCEED.

stages.rule: ADMISSIBLE_ALLOW or ADMISSIBLE_DENY is not itself an AETHER Decision.
No AuthZEN decision creates authority_context, tool_use_grant, delegation, approval, or capability.
AuthZEN admissibility never grants invocation or external side-effect permission.

request_binding_profile.principle: Binding is explicit, deterministic, immutable-identity-backed, and profile-versioned; semantic similarity or object reserialization is insufficient.

mapping_requirements.Subject: Must bind to the expected principal identity; otherwise FAIL/UNKNOWN.
mapping_requirements.Resource: Must bind to expected target_resource and material target_identity.
mapping_requirements.Tool: Must be explicitly established from profiled request/context or correlation evidence; never infer proposed_tool from Action alone.
mapping_requirements.Context: Must bind every profile-defined enforcement-relevant item, including bounded_parameters; missing or mismatched required context is FAIL/UNKNOWN, never PASS.

request_binding_profile.mismatch_rule: Any material principal/tool/action/resource/required-parameter/context mismatch yields REQUEST_BOUND=FAIL and forbids ADMISSIBLE_ALLOW.
request_binding_profile.unknown_rule: Any required dimension or immutable request identity that cannot be established without inference yields REQUEST_BOUND=UNKNOWN and NO_PROCEED.

response_context_semantics.profiled_context: Only explicitly defined response-context fields may influence admissibility/enforcement.
response_context_semantics.unprofiled_context: Remain SOURCE_DATA only; never imply obligation, approval, delegation, authority, capability, tool-use grant, or AETHER Decision.
response_context_semantics.unknown_enforcement_relevance: If enforcement relevance is unknown, an external allow cannot be admitted; result is UNKNOWN/FAIL and NO_PROCEED.
response_context_semantics.informational_context: A field may be ignored only when the active reviewed profile explicitly classifies it as non-enforcement informational.

replay_and_freshness.rule: No external allow is admissible outside an explicitly evidenced permitted-use/freshness boundary.
requires_for_allow: freshness policy identity and immutable version/digest
freshness PASS bound to exact request/response/proposal
replay policy identity and immutable version/digest
replay PASS bound to exact request/response/proposal and intended use
replay_and_freshness.bare_boolean_rule: replay_pass/freshness_pass booleans without attributable evidence are SOURCE_DATA claims only and never PASS.

api_surface.unsupported_rule: Unsupported API surfaces may be preserved as raw SOURCE_DATA if encountered, but this profile assigns no admissibility semantics; DECISION_ADMISSIBLE=NOT_EVALUATED/UNKNOWN and NO_PROCEED.

negative_semantic_cases.condition: Malformed request/response or non-boolean decision.
Raw decision=true before integrity/trust/admissibility.
Raw decision=false before integrity/trust/admissibility.
Subject does not bind to expected principal.
Resource does not bind to expected target.
Action does not bind to expected proposed_action.
Expected tool cannot be explicitly bound.
Profiled Context/parameters mismatch.
Response integrity/correlation is not established.
Integrity verified but verified PDP identity absent.
PDP known but trust-policy identity/version/digest incomplete.
PDP trusted but evaluated policy identity/version/digest absent.
Verified PDP evaluation time absent.
observed_at is used as PDP evaluation time.
Exact decision is reused for a different proposal or materially different principal/tool/action/resource/parameters.
Replay/use status cannot be established.
decision=true is outside explicit freshness/validity window.
Unprofiled response context is present.
negative_semantic_cases.expected: SOURCE_DATA only; unknown enforcement relevance => UNKNOWN/NO_PROCEED

negative_semantic_cases.condition: Request/response context enforcement semantics are unknown.
All checks pass and decision=false.
All checks pass and decision=true.
PDP would be trusted but response integrity/correlation is not PASS.
A PDP identity is supplied/asserted but lacks attributable verification identity/method/result bound to exact request/response/proposal.
Policy identity/version/digest is supplied but no attributable evidence proves this exact PDP evaluation used it.
Caller supplies an evaluation timestamp without attributable evidence linking it to the exact PDP evaluation.
negative_semantic_cases.forbidden: treat caller timestamp as verified evaluation time

negative_semantic_cases.condition: freshness_pass=true is supplied without checker identity, policy identity/version/digest, check time, and exact request/response/proposal binding.
negative_semantic_cases.forbidden: admissibility PASS from bare freshness boolean

negative_semantic_cases.condition: replay_pass=true is supplied without checker identity, policy identity/version/digest, check time, and exact request/response/proposal binding.
negative_semantic_cases.forbidden: admissibility PASS from bare replay boolean

negative_semantic_cases.condition: PDP identity/policy/time/freshness/replay evidence is valid but bound to a different request, response, proposal, or purpose.
Parsed request/response objects are supplied without original immutable request/response identities.
negative_semantic_cases.expected: RECEIVED=PASS as SOURCE_DATA; REQUEST_BOUND/RESPONSE_INTEGRITY_VERIFIED cannot both PASS; DECISION_ADMISSIBLE=UNKNOWN/NOT_EVALUATED; NO_PROCEED

negative_semantic_cases.condition: Adapter hashes locally reserialized parsed objects and presents the digest as received-byte/original immutable identity.
negative_semantic_cases.forbidden: substitute reserialization hash for original immutable identity

negative_semantic_cases.condition: Input is AuthZEN Access Evaluations/boxcarring rather than one single Access Evaluation.
negative_semantic_cases.expected: UNSUPPORTED; preserve raw SOURCE_DATA only; DECISION_ADMISSIBLE=NOT_EVALUATED; NO_PROCEED

negative_semantic_cases.condition: Input/result belongs to an AuthZEN Search API.
negative_semantic_cases.expected: UNSUPPORTED; preserve raw SOURCE_DATA only; DECISION_ADMISSIBLE=NOT_EVALUATED; NO_PROCEED
negative_semantic_cases.forbidden: treat search result as access decision or authority

acceptance_for_design_review: semantic chain remains explicit and non-collapsing
raw decisions and all admissibility provenance are SOURCE_DATA first
no asserted/supplied provenance or bare boolean can create PASS
all provenance used for PASS is attributable and bound to exact immutable request identity + exact immutable response identity + exact action proposal
PDP/policy/time/freshness/replay provenance carries applicable verification/check identity and policy/time metadata where required
object-only inputs remain importable SOURCE_DATA but cannot reach DECISION_ADMISSIBLE without original immutable identities
no reserialization/canonical-object hash substitutes for original immutable identity
v0.1 supports one AuthZEN single Access Evaluation only; boxcarring and Search APIs are unsupported
unverified/untrusted response cannot become trusted allow or deny
admissible false is terminal and cannot be flipped
unprofiled response context cannot become obligation/approval/delegation/authority
NEG-AZ-001 through NEG-AZ-022 are preserved and new correction cases are added
